result.summary: The twelfth trigger search was performed over a scope explicitly disjoint from rounds seven through eleven: eigenvalue and structured-matrix methods for resultant and polynomial-remainder computation -- Bezoutian-matrix eigenstructure and the Dixon hidden-variable resultant (C1), companion-matrix and Sylvester-matrix pencils restating modular composition (C2), u-resultants for multivariate elimination via a single linear form (C3), and multiplication-operator eigenvalue methods -- the Stetter-Moller theorem and Auzinger-Stetter matrices (C4) -- via the arXiv export API, which answered every query directly. C1 and C3 construct a matrix whose size is dominated by deg(r_R) = Theta(B^3), matching exactly the already-costed materialization cost of ROUTE-08's own dependency-graph node (n2, declared cost exponent 3) and of ROUTE-01's componentwise resultant. C2 is shown to BE ROUTE-05 (modular composition, Brent-Kung/Kedlaya-Umans lineage) under matrix-pencil vocabulary, not merely adjacent to it, since EXP-CREP-001's own route description names ROUTE-05 exactly that lineage. C4 is shown to generalize ROUTE-02 (quotient-ring resultants, described in EXP-CREP-001 exactly as 'resultant construction in the quotient-ring direction (r_R mod g_I)') precisely, and independently fails G2: two retrieved sources (arXiv:1805.09165, arXiv:2202.09226) confirm that building an Auzinger-Stetter or multiplication-operator matrix requires a Groebner basis or an already-known point set before construction, exactly the witness circularity every prior round's near-misses have failed on. Genuine internal-corpus prior art from a different elliptic setting (inputs/idea_generation_20260718_batch3.md's displacement-Bezoutian candidate and inputs/idea_generation_20260718_batch5.md's POWERPROJ-A1 multiplication-operator candidate, both dated 2026-07-18 and never promoted to a ledger hypothesis for these specific mechanisms) independently self-discloses the same two obstructions, and the ledger-recorded H-SUBRES-001/EXP-RT1476-001 measurement (a different hypothesis, toy scale, not generalizable per its own interpretation_limits) found no eliminant-degree collapse in that closely analogous elliptic setting, recorded as corroborating context only. Every candidate considered (C1-C4) is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8); none passes every item. The honest disposition is scoped_no_candidate, with the mandatory G8 comparison against ROUTE-08 discharged and sharpened to name the more precise ROUTE-02 and ROUTE-05 correspondents for C4 and C2 respectively.
result.preserved_scope: No B71 admission, experiment, evidence, ECDLP attack, speedup, novelty, closure, SOTA movement, or breakthrough is claimed. The coordinate-aware P1553 target-local remainder transducer and the exact dyadic subinterval unit-product interface remain open under their exact narrow boundaries, as does every broader preserved route, including eigenvalue and structured-matrix methods whose matrix can be built at sub-Theta(B^3) cost without a Groebner basis, root set, or equivalent witness of the joint complete-chart system (as an open resource beyond this round's specific formulations, not as an admitted trigger). Round ten's closed deck-local mixed-radix/CRT sub-avenue and round eleven's ROUTE-04 collapse were not reopened; no candidate this round touches that geometry or literature.
